content: Older adults are at an increased risk of experiencing hypoglycemia. This heightened risk is primarily due to factors such as the use of insulin and the presence of impaired kidney function. It is essential to identify and manage this risk effectively because episodes of hypoglycemia in this population can be severe and significantly diminish their quality of life. The use of continuous glucose monitoring systems and automated insulin delivery devices can play a crucial role in reducing the likelihood of hypoglycemia in older adults.
